_readme: THE LAST TRANSMISSIONS: every recording the radio carries. The static, the squelch and its tail are the receiver's physics (tools/bohemia_radio_cook.py, class Radio), not a recording and not a filter on noise; a CC0 recording of a real handheld replaces them when a machine can reach Freesound.
